title: Baby Sandra on Bathinette Table, 1947 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot showing a seven-month-old baby girl named Sandra lying on her stomach on a folding bathinette changing table. In the background of the room sits a cone-hat clown toy, a framed picture, a crucifix, and a devotional statue of the Virgin Mary, reflecting post-WWII Catholic American family life in March 1947.
